name: sextant
description: Scientific plotting for C++20 with the low friction of matplotlib: interactive OpenGL windows, PNG and SVG output.

freetype.description: Rasterize plot text with FreeType instead of stb_truetype

png.description: Write PNG files with libpng instead of stb_image_write

window-icon.description: Give every window the sextant icon in the title bar and taskbar (Windows, Linux X11)
